candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey convulse now. Pikin never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything wey e chop. Pikin na 18 months old. Pikin get cough or e dey struggle to breathe. Pikin no get diarrhoea. Pikin no get any ear problem. Pikin no get fever. Dem count how pikin dey breathe for one minute. Pikin chest dey go inside when e dey breathe. Pikin calm when dem dey check am. Pikin don dey cough for 3 days. Pikin dey exposed or e get HIV. Pulse oximeter no dey available. Pikin no dey get recurrent wheeze. Pikin dey breathe 35 times for one minute. Pikin no get stridor when e calm. Pikin no dey wheeze.
